### P9 "Key Frame Artifacts" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: Keeps an accumulation of difference since a key frame; categories: Glitch; inputs: inputImage:image, updateKeyFrame:bool=0, adaptRate:float=0, numColors:float=1, buffQuality:float=1; passes: 4

```glsl
vec3 cround (vec3 r)	{
	vec3 returnMe = r;
	returnMe.r = (fract(returnMe.r) < 0.5) ? floor(returnMe.r) : ceil(returnMe.r);
	returnMe.g = (fract(returnMe.g) < 0.5) ? floor(returnMe.g) : ceil(returnMe.g);
	returnMe.b = (fract(returnMe.b) < 0.5) ? floor(returnMe.b) : ceil(returnMe.b);	
	return returnMe;	
}

// … 52 more lines
```
